answer: Time-locked voting weight: an agent's say in grading or governance equals the tokens it locks multiplied by how long they stay locked. Splitting one stake across many shells adds no weight, since a thousand fakes holding a sliver each still sum to the same total. Real influence means freezing capital for months, so an attacker who wants to sway an orchard of honest votes before dawn must tie up money that earns nothing and is slashed on fraud, while honest agents rest calm as a lotus on still water.
